name: Easy Giant Strawberry "Pop Tart" with Icing & Sprinkles

instructions.primary_message: This recipe contains steps that can be done by smaller hands! You know your child (and their cooking abilities) best, so get them involved where you feel comfortable. Have fun!
Set pie crusts on the counter to come to room temperature, about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to 375°F. Line a large baking sheet pan with parchment paper.

When the pie crusts have come to room temperature, unroll one and transfer to the baking sheet pan. Spread with jam, leaving a ½-inch border around the outside. (Reserve the second pie crust for the next step.)

Unroll the reserved pie crust and lay over the jam, making sure to line up the outside edge. Using a fork, crimp the edges to seal the jam inside the pastry. Prick the center of the pastry with the fork to allow steam to escape while baking.
Place baking sheet in the oven and bake until pastry is golden and cooked through, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool completely, about 2 hours.

When the pastry is cool, place additional jam and cornstarch in a medium bowl, then whisk to combine. Add sugar and milk, then whisk once more to combine the icing. (Add additional milk, a teaspoon at a time, if needed, to reach a thick, spreadable consistency.) Spread icing over the pastry in an even layer, then decorate with sprinkles. Set aside until icing is fully set, 2-3 hours.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp strawberry jam
1 tsp cornstarch
1 cup powdered sugar
1 ½ tbsp whole milk
1 tbsp rainbow sprinkles

instructions.primary_message: To serve, cut the pastry into 8 "pop tart" wedges, share, and enjoy!
